name: North Coast X Pure Coast Hash Rosin Special Sauce | Strawberry Guava (Tier 2)
description: Special sauce starts as cold cure, then the terpenes are carefully separated and then reintroduced into the rosin resulting in a concentrate that's an explosion of exquisite flavors and captivating aromas. Every batch of Special Sauce undergoes an extended cold curing process, which allows the terpenes to mature and develop their full potential, creating a taste experience that's nothing short of extraordinary.
